notes.title: Major Update: New Levels, Excavator, Graphics Overhaul & UI Improvements(v1.5.1)
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a massive update! This update brings exciting new content, visual enhancements, and key improvements to make your VR excavating experience better than ever!
What’s New:🚧New Levels  Explore brand-new levels, each designed with unique challenges and environments to test your excavating skills.  From rugged mountain terrains to urban construction sites, prepare for more engaging and immersive gameplay!🚜 New Excavator  Introducing the new excavator! – a powerful and versatile machine built for tackling tough jobs.  Improved physics and handling make this excavator the most fun to operate yet!🎨 Graphics Overhaul  We’ve completely revamped the graphics for a more immersive and visually stunning experience.  High-resolution textures and improved lighting effects bring the game world to life.  Optimized performance ensures smoother gameplay, even in the most demanding scenes.🎮 UI Updates  We’ve redesigned the user interface to make navigation smoother and more intuitive.  Cleaner menus, improved tooltips, and VR-friendly controls for a seamless in-game experience.  HUD elements have been refined to give you clear, real-time feedback without cluttering the screen.Other Improvements:  Performance Optimizations: Tweaked the game for better FPS in VR across all supported hardware.  Bug Fixes: Addressed various bugs reported by the community to improve overall stability.
Thank you to all our players for your feedback and support! Dive in and try out the new contents.
